description: This file defines the UserRepository interface for data access operations related to User entities within a Spring Data JPA context. It extends JpaRepository to provide CRUD and query capabilities, and declares custom query methods.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Spring Data JPA repository interface for User entity with custom query methods.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Finds a User entity by email address.

methods.name: findBySupervisor
methods.description: Finds a list of User entities supervised by the specified user.
